status: Frozen full-capture validation protocol; not a completed comparison.
arms: standard global registration, linear cached weights
production local registration, squared cached weights
protocol: Use all retained frames with the same highest-quality anchor. Production local template uses its best 64 selected frames. Local arms share each raw mono projection; the global arm independently calculates standard best-frame shifts and uses the same cached linear scores. Abort if registration changes the paired frame set. No sharpening, exposure/geometry compensation, extra rejection or exponent sweep.
comparison: Same conventional 16-bit mono reference and 24087-pixel eroded interior as the pilot if all arms retain common support; remove only two rows per vertical edge to match reference dimensions. Global translation and gain/offset fits only. Require both RMS and fine-detail correlation to improve for each claimed gain.

control.result: Both shadow linear arms reproduce separate production global/local runs bitwise for image, coverage and validity.

limits: A developmental conventional-stack comparison does not establish universal accuracy. Keep defaults and ambiguity/fold guards unchanged. Source dependencies must remain frozen during this run.
